pair.title: Connect your OJ account
pair.intro: Sign in with the same account you use in the thermostat's app. All WiFi thermostats on the account will be found.
pair.error_required: Please enter your username and password.
pair.hint: Your thermostat must already be linked to this account in the app, and connected to WiFi.

device.offline: Thermostat is offline (no WiFi connection to the OJ cloud)
device.auth_failed: Sign-in to the OJ cloud failed. Use Repair to enter your credentials again.
device.no_credentials: No account linked. Use Repair to sign in.
device.no_data: No data received from the thermostat yet. Try again in a minute.
device.vacation_readonly: Vacation mode can only be planned in the OJ app or on the thermostat.
